$description: Hand-written. Motion timing, the same in every mode: a duration for state changes and a fast one for a state coming in, one easing, and --transition-base, the base duration and easing together. The color moves' own timings (button hover, line pulses, icons) live with their components.

base.$description: State changes: hover, focus, a theme switch, a surface moving.

fast.$description: A state coming in: a hover or focus state arriving, a tooltip opening. It leaves at the base duration.

org.openmined.was: the 0.15s typed into the components' hover-ins

base.$description: Duration and easing together, for a CSS transition: `transition: color var(--transition-base)`.
